modules.explorerLead: Select a module to understand its workflow, practical skills and related ETripleSoft Learn courses.
modules.bigPictureTitle: See how each module fits into the bigger picture
modules.bigPictureText: Begin with the area closest to your day-to-day work, then follow its workflow to see what happens next. Odoo carries information between teams, turning customer conversations into orders, deliveries and invoices without repeated data entry.

sales.name: Sales
sales.shortDescription: Manage quotations, sales orders, pricing, deliveries, and customer invoicing.
sales.overview: The Sales module runs the order-to-cash process—from a customer’s first quotation through delivery and final invoicing—and connects directly to Inventory and Accounting.

crm.name: CRM
crm.shortDescription: Manage leads, opportunities, activities, follow-ups, and pipeline progress.
crm.overview: CRM tracks a prospect from first contact to a won opportunity, giving sales teams a structured pipeline and a clear record of every follow-up.

accounting.name: Accounting
accounting.shortDescription: Manage invoices, vendor bills, payments, journals, and reconciliation.
accounting.overview: Accounting handles the financial side of each transaction: issuing customer invoices, recording vendor bills, tracking payments, and reconciling journals against bank statements.

inventory.name: Inventory
inventory.shortDescription: Control products, warehouses, receipts, deliveries, routes, and stock movements.
inventory.overview: Inventory manages stock across warehouses—receiving goods, reserving them against orders, picking, and shipping—using configurable routes that match real operations.

manufacturing.name: Manufacturing
manufacturing.shortDescription: Plan production with bills of materials, manufacturing orders, and work orders.
manufacturing.overview: Manufacturing turns a bill of materials into a production plan by scheduling manufacturing orders, tracking work at work centers, and recording finished goods.

purchase.name: Purchase
purchase.shortDescription: Manage requests for quotation, purchase orders, receipts, and vendor bills.
purchase.overview: Purchase runs procurement from the first request for quotation through vendor negotiation, purchase orders, goods receipt, and the resulting vendor bill.

human-resources.name: Human Resources
human-resources.shortDescription: Organize employees, attendance, leave requests, and essential HR operations.
human-resources.overview: Human Resources centralizes employee records, attendance, and time-off requests, with an approval flow that keeps managers and HR staff in sync.

website-ecommerce.name: Website and eCommerce
website-ecommerce.shortDescription: Build connected website and online-sales experiences integrated with Odoo operations.
website-ecommerce.overview: Website and eCommerce lets a business publish products online and take orders directly from its site, with each order flowing into delivery and invoicing.

help.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about enrolling in, accessing, and completing ETripleSoft Learn courses.
help.title: Help Center
help.lead: Answers to the questions learners ask most about enrolling in and completing ETripleSoft Learn courses.

items.question: How do I start a course?
items.answer: Open any course page and select “Start Learning.” If you are not signed in, you will be asked to sign in first, then the course opens in your learning area where you can enroll and begin the lessons.

items.question: Do I need any prior Odoo experience?
items.answer: It depends on the course. Beginner courses like the Odoo User Guide and Crash Course Odoo ERP assume no prior experience. Advanced tracks list their recommended preparation on each course page.

items.question: Are courses self-paced?
items.answer: Yes. Each course is organized into modules and lessons you can work through at your own pace, with a clear estimated duration shown on the course page.

items.question: Do courses include a certificate?
items.answer: Yes. Every course ends with a certificate of completion, awarded once you finish all modules in the curriculum.

items.question: What if a course is marked “Coming Soon”?
items.answer: Coming-soon courses are still in development. You can preview the planned curriculum on the course page and contact us to ask about the launch.

items.question: I have a question about a specific lesson. Who do I contact?
items.answer: Reach out to our team through the Contact page and mention the course and lesson — we’ll route your question to the right instructor.

items.question: How do I know which course or path is right for me?
items.answer: Visit Learning Paths for a role-based roadmap (End User, System Administrator, Implementer, Developer, or Automation Specialist), or use the role filter on the Courses page.

help.stillText: Our team is happy to answer questions we haven’t covered here.

sections.title: Your Rights

refund.metaDescription: Read ETripleSoft Learn’s seven-working-day course-fit guarantee, refund process, course exchange terms, and customer rights.
refund.title: Refund and Course Exchange Policy
refund.intro: A clear seven-working-day course-fit guarantee for online course purchases, alongside every mandatory right available under Egyptian law.

summary.title: 7 working days
summary.text: Request a refund or one-time exchange.

summary.title: A fair course-fit review
summary.text: Partial viewing alone does not block a request.

summary.title: Legal rights preserved
summary.text: Mandatory Egyptian consumer rights still apply.

sections.title: Seven-Working-Day Course-Fit Guarantee
paragraphs: A learner may request a full refund or a one-time course exchange within seven working days from the purchase date, provided the learner has not fully benefited from or completed the course.

A course may be considered fully used when all or substantially all course content has been completed or accessed, the final assessment has been completed, or a completion certificate has been issued.

Watching only part of a course does not automatically prevent a learner from submitting a request. ETripleSoft Learn may review available course activity to determine whether the course was fully consumed or whether the policy was misused. Where reliable activity evidence is unavailable, the request will be reviewed manually and will not be rejected on an assumed viewing percentage.

sections.title: Course Exchange
paragraphs: Within the seven-working-day guarantee period, a learner may request a one-time exchange for another available course. Access to the original course ends after the exchange is completed.

If the replacement course costs more, the learner pays the difference. If it costs less, our support team will confirm in writing how the difference will be handled before completing the exchange; the current platform does not publish an automated credit process.
An exchange is an additional option. It does not replace a refund where the learner is legally entitled to one.

sections.title: Defective, Inaccessible or Misdescribed Courses
sections.intro: The normal time and completion limitations do not apply when:
bullets: The learner did not receive course access.
The course is inaccessible because of a platform problem.
Essential advertised course content is missing.
The course is materially different from its published description.
The customer was charged more than once.
A refund or another remedy is required under applicable Egyptian law.
paragraphs: In these situations, ETripleSoft Learn may restore access, correct the problem, provide the course again, exchange the course, or issue a refund as appropriate.

sections.title: Refund Method and Timing
paragraphs: Eligible refunds are returned through the original payment method used with Kashier. ETripleSoft Learn reviews and decides refund requests; Kashier processes the payment refund.

ETripleSoft Learn does not charge the learner an administrative refund fee. An approved refund will be initiated within seven calendar days after the request is reviewed and approved. The learner’s bank or card issuer may need additional processing time before the amount appears in the account.

sections.title: How to Submit a Request
sections.intro: Email our support team and include:
bullets: Whether you are requesting a refund or an exchange.
A short explanation of the problem, when applicable.
paragraphs: The website does not currently have a request-submission backend, so email is the working request channel. Sending an email does not mean the request has already been approved.

sections.title: Statutory Rights
sections.callout: Nothing in this policy excludes or limits any mandatory rights available to customers under Egyptian consumer-protection law. Requests submitted outside the seven-working-day course-fit guarantee will still be reviewed where the purchased service was defective, unavailable, not as described, or where another remedy is required by applicable law.
